prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: hand-painted HD animation sprite atlas for Sam & Max Hit the Road. First image is the ONLY pose/shape reference, second image is the approved Sam identity/style master. Redraw the first image as clean smooth HD 2D cartoon artwork, preserving every pose, silhouette, hand position, face, clothing shape and colour. Match the master: stocky orange-brown cartoon dog Sam, long soft ears, big shiny black nose, tiny black oval eyes, blue-grey suit and rumpled fedora with black band and white tab, white shirt, blue-and-black diagonally striped tie, broad paws. Smooth dark fine outlines, simple shaded colour surfaces, no pixel staircases or fuzzy fringe.
Layout: keep exactly the same three columns and two rows, same reading order and clear empty gutters; each pose separate. Transparent RGBA background throughout, no grey, no checkerboard drawn into image. No labels, no numbers, no text, no scenery, no ground shadow, no crop at hat or hands. The source labels identify panels but must disappear in the output.
These are full-body front-facing Sam poses used in the dinosaur-tooth twine sequence. Preserve the EXACT source pose in each panel, including hand height, bent knees, mouth expression, hat tilt and spreading feet. Twine and dust are handled separately; draw only the connected Sam component visible in the first reference. If a tiny yellow twine attachment touches a hand in the reference, keep that small touching part. Normal suit only: no red harness, no goggles, no gloves, no extra accessories. If the source mouth is open keep its expression with clear white teeth where visible. His dog hands must retain all source-visible fingers and thumb.
